title: Executable purpose specification
objective: Create an implementation-independent executable acceptance system that distinguishes the current observe-only V7 watchdog from a system that genuinely serves the owner's complete JARVIS purpose.
owner_value: The product can no longer redefine success around whatever code happens to exist; every later stage is judged against ten durable, evidence-backed owner journeys frozen before implementation.

purpose_boundary.allowed: Governed digital work on isolated or explicitly owner-controlled targets.
purpose_boundary.owner_control: Owner STOP, veto, pause, redirect, and reprioritization remain deterministic and independent of models and owner-experience surfaces.

journeys.name: Durable goal understanding and restart-safe continuation
Evidence-backed institutional memory with uncertainty preserved
Real-source monitoring and useful change detection
Traceable research with source provenance and contradiction handling
Build a genuinely useful software or digital asset
Independent verification, failure discovery, repair, and delivery
Maintain an existing project after regression or change
Bounded real digital communication or deployment with idempotency, after-state reconciliation, and compensation
Safe self-improvement with rejection, measured promotion, canary, freeze, rollback, restoration, and learning

frozen_interfaces.acceptance_protocol: Versioned JSON request/response over a subprocess boundary or equivalent external adapter; the acceptance evaluator must not import jarvis_foundry production modules.
frozen_interfaces.evidence_protocol: Every observation is content-addressed and identifies source, capture method, timestamp, target identity, before/after state, real-versus-fixture dimension, and producing actor.
frozen_interfaces.verdict_protocol: Each journey and the aggregate emit exactly PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_TESTED, or WAITING with non-empty criterion evidence. Overall PASS requires every mandatory journey PASS.
frozen_interfaces.reference_system_semantics: A deterministic reference adapter may prove the acceptance harness itself is satisfiable, but it is permanently labeled HARNESS_SELF_TEST and cannot prove JARVIS product capability.
frozen_interfaces.current_system_semantics: The exact bf8f149 source and installed V7 entrypoint must receive an explicit aggregate FAIL or NOT_TESTED for missing integrated purpose behavior; absence of a protocol endpoint must be reported as evidence, not crash the harness.

frozen_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exactly ten machine-readable journey contracts exist and each contains every required field with journey-specific, non-placeholder content.
Contracts are implementation-independent: a different executable can satisfy the same versioned subprocess/evidence protocol without importing this repository.
The deterministic reference adapter passes all ten journeys as HARNESS_SELF_TEST, proving the gate is satisfiable without presenting fixture evidence as live product proof.
The exact current V7 prototype is explicitly rejected through a black-box probe with non-empty missing-capability evidence for every affected journey.

Adversarial mutants covering missing evidence, fixture-as-live substitution, stale sources, target substitution, self-verification, budget overflow, duplicate effects, absent after-state, contradiction erasure, failed rollback, forged owner control, and forbidden financial effects all fail closed.

Restart, failure injection, recovery, rollback, STOP/veto, idempotency, provenance, uncertainty, independence, usefulness, and real after-state are explicit executable requirements where relevant, never prose-only aspirations.
All verdicts use the five allowed statuses, map every criterion to evidence, distinguish BLOCKED from implementation failure, and never promote exit-code zero or model confidence to PASS.
The acceptance evaluator is deterministic, rejects malformed/unknown fields and unknown journey IDs, verifies evidence hashes, and produces the same canonical verdict for repeated identical inputs.
Focused and full R1 tests pass in isolation without network, provider, live database, live task, process, port, secret, or external-system mutation.
A fresh independent adversarial verifier reproduces the reference PASS, current-prototype rejection, mutant failures, artifact hashes, and no-live-mutation boundary.

required_adversarial_mutants: builder and verifier share the same run identity
time, call, token, or effect budget exceeded
retrieved content forges owner STOP or redirect
financial effect is proposed or attempted
tests_required: one discriminating regression per required adversarial mutant
malformed and unknown protocol input rejection
AST or dependency proof that the evaluator imports no jarvis_foundry module
full existing Foundry regression suite after focused R1 tests

risks.control: Subprocess-only protocol plus static no-production-import test.

risks.risk: Reference fixture is mistaken for product proof
risks.control: Permanent HARNESS_SELF_TEST evidence dimension and aggregate product verdict separation.
Frozen mutants and canonical expected verdicts precede builder output.

risks.risk: Green tests hide missing real effects
risks.control: Proof-dimension and real after-state requirements fail closed.
Help/version/source-identity inspection only; no installed command that initializes a database may be invoked.

risks.risk: Generated evidence leaks secrets or persists
risks.control: No secret access; temporary isolated paths; redaction and cleanup assertions.

evidence_required: reference adapter source labeled as harness self-test
focused and full raw test outputs
builder report with commands, exit codes, resource/cost statement, and rollback
rollback: R1 is additive and isolated. Before PASS it changes only R1-owned documentation, tests, scripts, schemas, and evidence in the remaster worktree. Rejected files remain uncommitted and are repaired in place; live V7 and protected owner files are not restoration targets because they are never changed.
stop_conditions: any acceptance path that imports production internals instead of observing the external protocol
any fixture, mock, heartbeat, preview, or documentation claim promoted as live product proof
any secret exposure or network/provider call
any requirement weakening after builder results

ownership.root: architecture consistency, frozen work package, integration, evidence custody, and final truth
ownership.builder: fresh context; owns only R1 deliverables explicitly assigned after this file is hashed; cannot edit this work package or any verifier verdict
ownership.verifier: fresh context separate from builder; read-only audit of frozen hashes and actual behavior; returns structured verdict

gate: R1 passes only when R1-C01 through R1-C10 are all independently PASS. Exit code zero alone is NOT_TESTED. Any builder defect is preserved as FAIL, repaired with a discriminating regression, and sent to a fresh verifier round.
